chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Abdillah informed me, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Safwan al-Bazufari, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Qutaibah, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan al-Nisaburi, from Ismail ibn al-Sabbah, who said:

I heard an elder narrating from Saif ibn Umaira, who said: I was in the company of Abu Ja'far al-Mansur, and I heard him say, starting from himself: 'O Saif ibn Umaira, there must be a caller who will call out the name of a man from the descendants of Abu Talib from the sky.' I asked: 'Does someone narrate this tradition?' He replied: 'By the One in whose hand is my soul, my ear heard him say: There must be a caller who will call out the name of a man from the sky.' I said: 'O Commander of the Faithful, I have never heard a report like this.' He said: 'O Saif, when that happens, we will be the first to answer it, for he is one of our cousins.' I asked: 'Which cousins?' He said: 'A man from the descendants of Fatima (peace be upon her).' Then he said: 'O Saif, if I had not heard Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him) narrating this to me, and then the people of the world had not narrated it to me, I would not have accepted it from them, but it is Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him).'

key_terms.أَبُو طَالِبٍ: Abu Talib, father of Ali ibn Abi Talib
key_terms.فَاطِمُ عَلَيْهَا السَّلَامُ: Fatima, daughter of the Prophet Muhammad

ai.seo_question: What did Caliph al-Mansur say about the future announcement from the sky regarding the Imam from the descendants of Fatima?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the Abbasid Caliph al-Mansur’s personal conviction in the Imamate of the Ahl al-Bayt, specifically linking the future Mahdi to the lineage of Fatima al-Zahra. Al-Mansur validates the tradition not merely through its chain but by prioritizing the authority of Imam Muhammad al-Baqir, illustrating the early political and theological recognition of the Imams even by their rivals. The mention of a celestial caller underscores the divine nature of the Mahdi’s reappearance, a key eschatological sign in Shia tradition.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 423 - It is narrated from Husain bin Ubaidullah from Abu Ja’far Muhammad bin Sufyan Bazufari from Ahmad bin Idris from Ali bin Muhammad bin Qutaibah from Fadhl bin Shazan Nishaburi from Ismail bin Sabbah that he said:

“I heard from an elder that Saif bin Umaira narrated: Once I was in the company of Abu Ja’far Mansur Dawaniqi. I heard him say: O Saif bin Umaira, it is inevitable that the name of a man from the descendants of Abu Talib will be announced from the sky. I asked: Has someone reported a tradition about it? He replied: By the one in whose control my life is, I have directly heard that an announcement will be made from the sky in the name of a person. I said: O chief of believers, but I have never heard any such report? He replied: O Saif, when there is such an announcement, I will be the first to harken to it, except that it would be in favor of one of my cousins. I asked: Which cousins. Mansur said: From the descendants of Lady Fatima (s). Then he said: O Saif, if I had not heard this from Abu Ja’far Muhammad bin Ali (a.s) I would not have believed it even if the whole world had stated thus.
